explication: Invoice Builder is an offline-first invoicing and quoting application, with desktop SQLite and optional self-hosted web access using SQLite or PostgreSQL. Users select or connect a database, manage business records, create invoices or quotes, then preview and export documents; supporting branches include reports, layouts, backups, and e-invoicing. The graph combines documented product capabilities with relationships visible in sampled source and the source index. Several feature implementations and transport details were not sampled, so those connections are documented rather than inferred from names alone.
